rationale: 候选命题止于『Experime』中途截断。源文本实验与结果关键命题全部缺失：模型与数据集列举『Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4, DeepSeek-LLM-7B, GPT-oss-20B』『HeadQA, MedQA-USMLE, and PubMedQA』、数值结果『average accuracy of 0.820』『strongest single model (0.777)』『majority voting ensembles (up to 0.789)』及结论。数值级差异永不级（§6.5）→ not_equivalent（E3）。
